  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The label read maps both a failed `gh api` call and a successful read with zero labels to an empty `LABELS`, so the new `elif [ -n "${LABELS}" ]` leaves `ALT_APPROVED_POSTED=1` when the issue has left `ai:awaiting-approval` with no labels.
  WHY: If the issue later returns to `ai:awaiting-approval`, the `/approved` post is skipped and the alt-model wait can run to its 4500 s deadline. Reviewers rated this MAJOR, which is mapped to high here. The anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 reviewer dropped the same concern as speculative (confidence 1, NIT), and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash declined to report it. The added test cannot tell a failed read from an empty one.

  PROBLEM: A successful read with an empty label set leaves `ALT_APPROVED_POSTED=1` after the `elif [ -n "${LABELS}" ]` change. The reviewer checked this and dropped it as speculative, so it was not reported as a finding.
  WHY: The failure needs the issue to go from `ai:awaiting-approval` to zero labels and back, and nothing in the code or run evidence shows that state. A re-plan adds labels such as `ai:planning` or `ai:clarification` in between. Re-arming on an empty read would bring back the flood of `/approved` comments.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:5025-5028 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `LABELS=""` comes from both a failed `gh api` call and a successful read of an issue with no labels. The new `elif [ -n "${LABELS}" ]` resets the flag in neither case, so it under-resets on a legitimate "no labels" read.
  WHY: Once `/approved` has been posted, a poll that returns empty labels leaves the flag at 1. When `ai:awaiting-approval` appears again the POST is skipped, and the loop waits until the 4500 s deadline. The test `test_alt_model_wait_keeps_flag_across_a_failed_label_read` (lines 206-211 of `tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_alt_model_cleanup_pr_selector.py`) cannot tell a failed read from an empty one. The reviewer notes the trigger is narrow.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:5011-5012, 5025-5028 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The label read maps both an API failure and a successful zero-label response to an empty `LABELS`. The reset condition therefore keeps `ALT_APPROVED_POSTED=1` even when a successful read confirms the issue left `ai:awaiting-approval`.
  WHY: If all labels are removed after one `/approved` post and the issue later returns to `ai:awaiting-approval`, the new post is skipped and the alt-model wait can time out. The added failed-read test uses an empty response from a successful fake `gh` call, so it does not distinguish the two cases.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
